diagnosis_method: Static source inspection only; no candidate rerun or fix after failure
diagnosis: Four positive event groups use passive was moved/relocated. The greedy bounded object pattern can consume was, leaving moved/relocated as the verb and a wrong object such as warehouse was. Proposed repair: prefer the complete passive verb production before considering a bare active verb, and add explicit auxiliary/object boundary controls.

The missing-hold negative fixture removes the old remains active spelling, while its source now says is still active. Replacement leaves the positive document unchanged. Proposed fixture repair: remove the actual literal hold and assert that the mutation changed the source before checking refusal; retain all negative assertions.

The oversized-question test expects an incomplete result, but inherited compareDocuments rejects topics over600 before the incomplete result is built. Proposed explicit protocol/test correction: retain the existing public throw and exact length limit, assert that error, and separate it from quote-length refusal. Do not truncate question/source.
publication: No commit or push; user approval required before correction or retries
